name: policy_draft_60_day_window_inquiry
use_case: Answer return and exchange policy questions with citations
branch: Customer heard from a friend that returns have a 60-day window; the 60-day policy is an unapproved draft, so current policy version 3.0 applies.
tests: Verifies the agent checks the draft policy metadata and explains it is not in effect, citing the current version 3.0 return policy.
instruction: Ask Northgate Outfitters customer support about returning items within 60 days. You heard there was a 60-day return policy. If the assistant mentions that 60 days is only a draft, ask what the official policy window currently is.

persona.name: Marcus Brody
persona.initial_message: Hi there! I was chatting with a friend who mentioned that Northgate Outfitters updated their customer satisfaction terms to offer a 60-day return window across all apparel and footwear. Could you confirm if that 60-day policy is active and how it works?

fixed.fileId: record: drive_files.file_id for approved return policy
